adjudication.rationale: In packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts, updateEvent sets `selectedCalendar` to `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId` and deleteEvent similarly sets `calendarId` with `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the else branch), the predicate compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` (undefined/null), so it will not find a normal calendar externalId and yields `undefined`. Unlike createEvent (which explicitly falls back to `"primary"`), these update/delete paths now lose the prior fallback to `event.destinationCalendar.externalId` and can pass an undefined calendarId to the Google API, causing broken updates/deletes for references lacking externalCalendarId.
